label: Act is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to potency at the supplied predicate
paraphrase: Act is simply prior to potency: whatever is in potency in a respect is simply posterior to some being that is in act in that respect.
note: Each application fixes the supplied InPotency predicate. The generic declaration admits independently supplied potency and specialization to the adopted potency predicate. The argument fixes the application, including its potency reading.
